set.prevailing_wage_basis: 24 CFR 983.153(c)(2) (HUD PBV development requirements): development involving nine or more contract units must pay Davis-Bacon wages and comply with 29 CFR part 5; 24 CFR 983.4 lists labor standards for projects of nine or more assisted units (eCFR, https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-24/subtitle-B/chapter-IX/part-983). Does not apply to existing housing PBVs or to developments with fewer than nine PBV units.
